newsitem.title: USA: Etec Systems falls on product delay.
newsitem.headline: Etec Systems falls on product delay.

text.p: Shares of Etec Systems Inc fell over 15 percent on Wednesday after it pushed back the introduction of its Polyscan products into the third quarter.
Etec fell 7-7/8 to 37-1/4 in afternoon trade on Nasdaq.
On Tuesday the company posted record second quarter earnings but warned of the product delay.
"A disappointment during the second quarter was a delay in shipping the first Etec Polyscan products," said Steve Cooper, Etec's chairman, president and chief executive officer.
"Initial product introduction has slipped from the second quarter to the third quarter to ensure product quality and reliability," he added in a statement.

The company made a presentation Wednesday at the Robertson Stephens & Co Tech '97 conference in San Francisco although a company spokeswoman said the company made no other negative statements in its presentation.
Etec Polyscan, located in Tucson, Arizona, develops and makes laser direct imaging pattern generation systems for the semiconductor and electronics industries.
On Tuesday Etec reported second quarter profits of $7.6 million or $0.35 a share compared with $3.5 million, or $0.18 a share in the year-ago quarter.
